copy.heading: Final assessment

items: When asked "How was your day?" you answered in two sentences and asked a question back.
You have not mentioned the 7th in two weeks.
The golf bag is no longer in the downstairs loo.
You mowed the lawn and there is no flag in it.
You have attended a family occasion from beginning to end.
You said "back by one" and were back by one.
You know the date of your wedding anniversary without looking.
You went on a family holiday that was not chosen for the courses.
You got through a sunny Saturday in April and were home when you said you would be.
You have handed the barbecue tongs to someone else without swinging them first.

copy.instructions: Award yourself one point for each statement that is true. Sue will check your answers, and has already checked them.
